FN-PSL46RG-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 245
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/03/2026
Senate Bill 245 as introduced would reduce potential income tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an estimated average of $1.5 million annually, beginning in fiscal year 2028 and each
year thereafter, by allowing an income tax deduction for certain qualified health care sharing
expenses for members of a health care sharing ministry.

FN-PSL46RG-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 245
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/04/2026
Senate Bill 245 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would reduce
potential income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated average of $1.5
million annually, beginning in fiscal year 2028 and ending in fiscal year 2030, by allowing an
income tax deduction for certain qualified health care sharing expenses for members of a health
care sharing ministry.
